lines.speaker: Alva
lines.text: The Vaal used this device to operate the mechanisms in the canal, but we would need a special artefact to power it. From the translations I've made, I believe they were called 'Soul Cores'. I've never even seen an in-tact Soul Core large enough for something like this though... I suppose if you want to try and find one you could ask our guide, Servi.
